summary.headline: Cloud PKI deployment models and macOS update-policy guidance are added
summary.overview: New Intune documentation covers Cloud PKI deployment models and managing macOS software updates with policies, while existing Security Copilot vulnerability-remediation, Remote Help, and cloud-attach references are refreshed.
summary.adminImpact: PKI administrators should compare the new deployment-model guidance with their certificate strategy. Apple management teams should review the current macOS software-update policy material before changing servicing configurations.

keyChanges.title: Cloud PKI deployment models guidance is added
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft published a new reference covering deployment models for Microsoft Intune Cloud PKI.

keyChanges.title: macOS software-update policy guidance is added
keyChanges.detail: New documentation covers using Microsoft Intune policies to manage macOS software updates.

keyChanges.title: Vulnerability Remediation Agent management guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: The Security Copilot documentation for managing the Vulnerability Remediation Agent was revised.

summary.headline: Edge app protection and enterprise app catalog guidance are added
summary.overview: The day introduces an app-protection-policy step for Microsoft Edge for Business and a guide to adding Enterprise App Catalog apps to Intune. Documentation for Autopilot device preparation, co-management enrollment, and Remote Help deployment also changes.
summary.adminImpact: Teams deploying Edge for Business data protection should assess the new policy guidance before rollout. App-management owners can use the Enterprise App Catalog reference to plan packaging and deployment workflows.

keyChanges.title: Edge for Business app-protection-policy guidance is added
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft added step-two guidance for creating app protection policies for Microsoft Edge for Business.

keyChanges.title: Enterprise App Catalog app guidance is added
keyChanges.detail: New documentation describes adding an Enterprise App Catalog app to Microsoft Intune.

keyChanges.title: Remote Help deployment guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: The Intune documentation for Remote Help deployment was updated.

summary.headline: Passwordless authentication guidance is refreshed
summary.overview: The archive contains two updates to the Intune passwordless documentation, including the passwordless authentication reference.
summary.adminImpact: Use the current passwordless reference when validating deployment instructions or end-user support material.

keyChanges.title: Passwordless authentication documentation is updated
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft updated the Intune passwordless authentication guidance.

summary.headline: The week adds policy, PKI, enrollment, and Security Copilot agent guidance
summary.overview: A very high-volume week introduces Edge for Business app-protection policy guidance, Cloud PKI deployment models, Windows enrollment material, and continued Security Copilot vulnerability-remediation updates.
summary.adminImpact: Prioritize review of the new policy and Cloud PKI materials where related deployments are planned. Use the refreshed Copilot agent guidance to validate security-operations ownership and the Windows enrollment guide to update onboarding procedures.

keyChanges.title: Edge for Business app-protection-policy guidance is added
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft published a new step for creating app protection policies for Microsoft Edge for Business.

keyChanges.title: Cloud PKI deployment models guidance is added
keyChanges.detail: New documentation explains deployment models for Intune Cloud PKI.

keyChanges.title: Windows device enrollment guide is added
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft published an Intune guide for Windows device enrollment.

summary.headline: Group Policy migration guidance is added alongside device-management updates
summary.overview: The day introduces Microsoft guidance for migrating imported Group Policy settings to an Intune policy, with updates to Configuration Manager feature lifecycle material, DFCI management, education device apps, and multi-device queries.
summary.adminImpact: Administrators transitioning Group Policy imports should use the new migration guide to review their conversion plan. Also check updated DFCI and device-query documentation before related operational work.

keyChanges.title: Imported Group Policy migration guidance is added
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft added documentation for migrating an imported Group Policy to a policy in Microsoft Intune.

keyChanges.title: DFCI management guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: The Windows Autopilot documentation for DFCI management was revised.

keyChanges.title: Multiple-device query guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: The Intune Advanced Analytics reference for querying multiple devices was updated.
